exhibits.title: The five questions a foreign payments firm asks, answered
exhibits.subtitle: Answer, deciding evidence and how sure we are · desk research to early Oct 2026
exhibits.source: Source: [Yoma FY2026]; [Bloomberg May 2026]; [UN Thailand 2025]; [OFAC 2023]; [FATF Jun 2026]; [Kira estimates]
rows: How big is the market, and how has it grown?
Wallet transfers of MMK 160-190 trn a year; inbound remittances ~US$8 bn in 2025, of which US$5.6 bn official
Wave MMK 34 → 48.9 trn [Yoma FY2026]; official remittances 8x since 2022 [Bloomberg May 2026]
Wallets lead domestic payments; Thailand sends about two-thirds of remittances; migrant families are the core user group
KBZPay 19 m active users [Fintech News 2025]; 4.1 m Myanmar nationals in Thailand [UN Thailand 2025]
What drives and holds back demand to 2030?
Migration and wallet habit drive it; the rate gap, freezes and conflict hold it back. Base case ~US$10 bn inbound by 2030
Conversion rule cut to 15% [A&G Jan 2026]; GDP -2.0% FY2025/26 [WB Dec 2025]
Who are the players and how concentrated?
Two wallets (KBZPay, Wave) and one bank group (KBZ) dominate; 14 licensed transfer firms
KBZ ~40% of banking [bne]; 14 licences [Myanmar Now Jan 2024]
Which risks and sanctions apply to foreign firms?
US sanctions on state FX banks, FATF call for action, new licensing and ownership disclosure; foreign players screen counterparties and stay MMK-only onshore
